sections.dashboard: An overview of your money: balances, budgets and what is coming up.
sections.transactions: Every income, expense and transfer, with search and filters.
sections.accounts: Your bank accounts, cash and cards, in any currency.
sections.categories: Income and expense categories, grouped the way you think about money.
sections.budgets: Spending limits per category, and how much of each is left.
sections.calendar: Past and planned transactions, laid out by date.
sections.reports: Spending, income and trends over time.
sections.settings: Your profile, language, currency and preferences.
sections.admin: Accounts on this Monevo instance, the identity provider connection and instance settings.

placeholder.body: This section is coming in a later stage.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no page at this address.
notFound.hint: The link may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: Monevo hit an unexpected error while showing this screen.
errorPage.hint: Reloading the page usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, go back to the dashboard.

pwa.updateMessage: A new version of Monevo is ready.
pwa.offlineReady: Monevo is ready to work offline.

auth.unreachableBody: Check your connection and try again.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.body: This action needs a recent sign-in. You'll confirm your identity with your sign-in provider and come back here; then try the action again.

conflict.reopen: Close this dialog and open it again to see the latest version.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Monevo uses your organization's account for sign-in. Your financial data stays private to you.
login.hint: You'll be redirected to your sign-in provider and brought back here.

errors.idp_unavailable: The sign-in provider isn't reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.login_failed: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
errors.access_denied: Sign-in was cancelled or access was denied.
errors.account_deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
errors.reauth_mismatch: You confirmed with a different account. Sign in again with the account you use in Monevo.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Monevo
onboarding.body: A few settings before you start. You can change the language and time zone later.
onboarding.baseCurrencyHint: Totals and reports use this currency. You can change it later in Settings.

fieldErrors.BASE_CURRENCY_LOCKED: Change the base currency in its own section of Settings.
fieldErrors.AMOUNT_PRECISION: This currency doesn't allow that many decimal places.
fieldErrors.BASE_CURRENCY_UNCHANGED: This is already your base currency.
fieldErrors.CURRENCY_INACTIVE: This currency is no longer available.

baseCurrencyChange.title: Base currency
baseCurrencyChange.description: Totals and reports are shown in your base currency. Account currencies and the amounts you enter stay as they are.
baseCurrencyChange.confirmBody: Your base currency will change from {{from}} to {{to}}. Accounts keep their own currencies and opening balances; only the currency used for totals changes.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.body: Sign out of devices you don't recognize or no longer use.

apiTokens.title: Personal API tokens
apiTokens.body: Tokens let your own scripts and integrations use the Monevo API with the permissions you choose.
apiTokens.name: Name

permissions.exchangeRatesCreate: Look up exchange rates and add manual rates

apiTokens.secretOnce: Copy this token now. For your security it won't be shown again.
apiTokens.revokeBody: Integrations using “{{name}}” will stop working immediately. This can't be undone.

accounts.description: Bank accounts, cash and cards, each in its own currency. Balances arrive with transactions.
accounts.emptyBody: Add the accounts you use, such as a bank account, cash or a credit card.
accounts.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted permanently. Archive it instead if you only want to hide it.

fields.name: Name
fields.openingBalanceHint: The balance on the opening date. Use a minus sign for debt.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Income and expense categories with optional subcategories.

fields.name: Name
fields.typeLocked: The type can't change for a subcategory or a category with subcategories.
fields.parentLocked: A category with subcategories can't become a subcategory.

categories.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted permanently. Archive it instead if you only want to hide it.
categories.deleteBodyWithChildren_one: “{{name}}” and its {{count}} subcategory will be deleted permanently.
categories.deleteBodyWithChildren_other: “{{name}}” and its {{count}} subcategories will be deleted permanently.

settings.title: Instance settings
settings.rateProviderHint: Where Monevo fetches exchange rates when they are needed. Manual rates always take priority.

idp.title: Identity provider
idp.adminGroupUnset: Not set: roles are managed in Monevo

users.title: Accounts
users.rolesManaged: Roles follow the “{{group}}” group in the identity provider.

promote.title: Make administrator?
promote.body: {{name}} will be able to manage accounts and instance settings. Administrators never see other users' financial data.

demote.title: Remove administrator role?
demote.body: {{name}} will no longer have access to administration.

deactivate.title: Deactivate account?
deactivate.body: {{name}} will be signed out everywhere and can't sign in until reactivated. Their data is kept.

activate.title: Reactivate account?
activate.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.
